description: Stream executeSandboxCommand. POST /sandboxes/{sandboxId}/commands with `stream: true` answers 200 application/x-ndjson, one CommandStreamFrame per line (the spec's own components.schemas.CommandStreamFrame), and JSON without it, but the converter reads only application/json bodies, so the operation generated with only its JSON output. Mark it as streaming when its input asks, with CommandStreamFrame as its frame, so it generates as API.makeStreaming: the plain call keeps its JSON output, and `.stream(input)` sends `stream: true` and emits each frame as Boat writes it. The frame is CommandStreamFrame plus the members of CommandResponse that the spec says the `exit` frame carries ("the synchronous result without stdout/stderr"). @boatdev/sdk's streamCommand reads the same stream.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: started: the command's record in the command history.
stdout/stderr: the chunk of output, UTF-8.
True when the memory ceiling killed the command or one of its processes and the command failed.
error: true when the command provably never ran (the sandbox is still restoring its disk), so sending it again is safe.

One line of a streamed command (`POST /sandboxes/{sandboxId}/commands` with `stream: true`, application/x-ndjson).
- `started`: first line. `commandId`.
- `stdout` / `stderr`: a chunk of output in `data`.
- `exit`: last line when the command ended. The synchronous result without stdout/stderr: `success`, `exitCode`, `signal`, `oomKilled`, `timedOut`, ...
- `error`: last line on a failure. `error`, `message`, `retryable`.

patches.value: Stream the output as the command writes it: the response is newline-delimited JSON (application/x-ndjson), one CommandStreamFrame per line. Ignored with detached. `executeSandboxCommand.stream(input)` sends it for you and emits each frame; a plain call with it set fails to decode the stream.
